Items under check: Number of quotes fits the amount (up to R10,000: one quote from approved supplier database; R10,000–R30,000 incl. VAT: three quotes; R30,000–R499,999: three quotes on 80/20 system)
Quote received by the RFQ closing date and time (late quotes not considered)
Quote is still valid (not older than 1 month)
Calculations on the quotation are correct
All documents the RFQ asked for are attached (CIPC registration, certified ID copies of owners, tax compliance status with PIN, B-BBEE certificate or sworn affidavit, SBD 4, latest CSD report)
CSD report is recent (not older than 30 days at submission)
Tax compliance status / PIN is valid and not expired by the payment date
B-BBEE certificate or sworn affidavit has not expired (affidavit valid 12 months from signing)
Certified copies are recent (certification stamp not older than 6 months)
SBD 4 is attached, fully completed (all YES/NO answered) and signed
No director is a state employee and supplier is not on the restricted list
Same supplier on every document (company registration number matches on quote, order, invoice, CSD, payment)
VAT charged only if supplier is a VAT vendor; VAT number matches the CSD report

Requisition approved at the right level (Deputy Manager up to R30,000; Manager up to R100,000; Executive Manager R100,000–R200,000; Deputy Secretary R200,000–R250,000; Accounting Officer R250,000+), with name and rank shown
Purchase order approved by Deputy Manager, Manager and CFO in SCM (approval record present in file)
Invoice date comes after the quote and the order date (otherwise motivation approved by AO/CFO)
Paid within 30 days of receiving the invoice
Quote, order, invoice and payment amounts agree
Paid to the supplier's own bank account (account on remittance matches quote, invoice and CSD report)
Every page in the file belongs to this payment (order, invoice, control form, supporting documents; nothing from another payment)
Pre-audit done and checklist signed
Post-audit done and checklist signed by the auditor
